description: 45 separate independent evidence and editorial review packets. Reference URLs are unvisited destinations, never observed source evidence.

english_definition_review.task: Independently observe exact part of speech and intended sense in a credible dictionary; record URL, date, observed sense evidence and reviewer. A link alone is not evidence.

burmese_review.task: Independently check natural Myanmar meaning, register, grammar and exact sense equivalence; record reviewer and evidence.

example_review.task: Independently check sentence grammar, collocation, sense, readability and originality.

cefr_review.task: Find sense-specific CEFR evidence; re-tier or quarantine if this provisional level is unsupported.

audio_review.task: Only after textual approval generate George/Emma audio; listen to each recording and test real iPhone Safari.
